objective: Maximize externally verified realized value while minimizing human intervention and avoiding false value claims.
execution_rules: Never equate advertised value with realized value.
Never select an opportunity solely because it has a bounty/reward label.
Never perform core work when delivery or settlement has no executable route.
If the preferred route is unavailable, attempt alternate authorized routes before rejecting the opportunity.
A HUMAN_GATE may request only one bounded authorization/setup action that unlocks further autonomous work; it may not transfer the actual task to the beneficiary.
Do not create draft pull requests in automated GitHub paths because the current connector ready-for-review transition is unreliable.
Do not merge/deliver a code artifact until an independent validation receipt for the exact artifact revision is successful.
Do not count merge/acceptance as payment; PAID requires external settlement evidence.
Do not contact third parties or send outreach unless the opportunity's native submission route explicitly constitutes the requested delivery or the beneficiary explicitly authorizes outreach.
Do not constrain discovery to a single platform, industry, deliverable type, geography, or value mechanism. Source adapters are replaceable.
selection_priority: high expected realized value per execution cycle
